extName.message: Microcopy Lab – Text variants for UX tests

extDescription.message: Swap labels, titles and button texts on any website from a spreadsheet to test wording variants in usability tests.

optTagline.message: Test wording variants on any website – driven by a simple table.

optHelpBody.message:
Header row: page · type · original · any number of variant columns (A, B, Short …) · note. Columns found, id and key are ignored. German headers (seite, typ, notiz) work too.

page: * = everywhere, /app = exactly this page, /app/groups/* = including sub-pages. IDs in addresses become :id automatically (e.g. /app/groups/:id/settings). More specific entries win.

type: text (visible), placeholder (input fields), tooltip, aria (screen readers). Empty = text.

Placeholders: {n} devices → {n} sensors. Works for texts that appear as one piece on the page.

Empty cell in a variant = the original text stays.

optPrivacyBody.message:
Microcopy Lab has no server and no analytics. Tables, settings and collected texts are stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and never leave your device.

The extension only runs on websites you enable yourself. The only network request it makes is downloading a table from an address you enter (e.g. a Google Sheet) – no data is sent along.

Removing a website or uninstalling the extension deletes its data.
